snippet.title: ETERNAL HAUNT | Midsummer Night's Scream: A HORROR GAME AWARDS SHOWCASE 2026
snippet.description:
Wishlist & Play the Demo now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2900990/Eternal_Haunt/

Set in old Japan, Eternal Haunt is a first person atmospheric survival horror game. Avoid the deathly cold grasp of Yuki-Onna and her ten ghost children. Solve dynamic puzzles, scavenge for items, piece together a tragic story from totems, call upon cursed spells with ofudas and find your lost grandson. 
---
Originally aired during MIDSUMMER NIGHT'S SCREAM: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Monday 1 June 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.

Website: https://thehorrorgameawards.com/
Merch: https://store.thehorrorgameawards.com/
